name: dekernai
description: TypeScript SDK for the DekernAI API: agentic payment controls (sandbox, test networks only)

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node scripts/mark-cjs.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/*.test.mjs test/*.test.cjs
